name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: SEO & Paid Search Strategist | Home Services, Google Ads & Local Lead Generation
summary: Growth marketer with 15+ years in agency and marketing-operations work, currently running full-funnel SEO and paid-search strategy for local service businesses through my own practice. Own Google Ads accounts end to end - from build to daily optimization - for home-service and B2B clients, and run technical SEO audits, keyword and competitor research, and on-page fixes directly inside client CMS platforms. Comfortable leading client calls myself and translating strategy into plain language for a business owner who wants leads, not a ranking report. Judge performance by lead quality and conversion, not clicks or traffic in isolation.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own Google Ads accounts end to end for local service-based businesses: built campaigns from the ground up, then rebuilt targeting and negative keywords on an underperforming account to cut spam and low-quality leads and improve click-through quality.

Diagnosed a stalled-conversion account by tracing the remaining gap past the ad platform to the website's conversion path, rather than declaring the campaign fixed on click metrics alone - the same lead-quality-over-clicks judgment this role calls for.

Conduct technical SEO audits, keyword gap analyses, and competitor and SERP research, implementing on-page fixes - titles, meta descriptions, headers, internal linking - directly inside client CMS platforms.
Install and configure Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking on every client website built, validating tags before launch.

Track acquisition, conversion, and lead quality in GA4 and Google Search Console across multiple concurrent client accounts, adjusting strategy based on what the data shows rather than producing a report and moving on.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners, including home-services businesses, on reputation-management and local-visibility tools (Google Business Profile optimization, review generation).
Advised partners on local search visibility and customer-health metrics, retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Led digital growth consultations aligning site architecture, on-page SEO, and inbound marketing to improve client traffic and conversion, working directly in client site content and metadata.
Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (Sept 2024)
